steps.label: 01 · Request
steps.title: Tell us about your vehicle
steps.body: Share your vehicle’s make, model, year and the area where you need service. Add the VIN if you have it and a description of the windshield to help Vitreva prepare your quote.

steps.label: 02 · Confirm
steps.title: Let’s clarify the details
steps.body: Vitreva gets back to you to clarify the quote, your vehicle’s needs and availability. Mention cameras and driver assistance features. If ADAS calibration is required, we refer you to an appropriate provider. Your appointment still needs confirmation.

steps.label: 03 · Replacement
steps.title: Your agreed mobile service
steps.body: Once the location and appointment are confirmed, Vitreva comes to you for the agreed replacement. Aftercare instructions and the time before you can drive again are explained for the conditions of your particular installation.

privacy.title: Privacy
paragraphs: You can browse this site without creating an account. The site does not use audience analytics or store your request in your browser.

When you submit a request, the details you enter are sent to Vitreva through Web3Forms, the form provider used on this site. They are used to understand your needs, prepare a quote and respond to you. Web3Forms also processes the data needed to deliver the form according to its own practices.
Please do not send sensitive information that is unnecessary for your request. Your VIN is optional.
For questions about your personal information, or to request its correction or deletion, email contact@vitreva.ca.

terms.title: Terms of use
paragraphs: This site presents Vitreva’s mobile windshield replacement service in Gatineau and lets you request a quote.
Submitting a request does not confirm a price or an appointment. The work, price, location and availability must be confirmed directly with Vitreva.
ADAS calibration needs are referred to an appropriate provider. Aftercare instructions are provided for your particular installation.
Illustrative photographs show the service; they are not evidence of completed jobs.
For any questions, contact Vitreva at contact@vitreva.ca.

items.question: What do I need for a quote, and where is my VIN?
items.answer: Start with your vehicle’s year, make and model, your area and a short description of what you need. Your VIN is helpful if you have it: look on your registration or insurance documents, or at the lower driver-side windshield. You can also contact us without the VIN so we can work through the details together.

items.question: Which areas do you serve?
items.answer: We serve Gatineau (Hull, Aylmer, Buckingham and Masson-Angers), Cantley, Chelsea, L’Ange-Gardien, Val-des-Monts, La Pêche, Pontiac, Notre-Dame-de-la-Salette, Thurso, Mayo, Lochaber, Lochaber-Partie-Ouest, Denholm, Low, Saint-Sixte, Bowman, Mulgrave-et-Derry and Plaisance, depending on your address within roughly 50 km of our Gatineau base, in Quebec only. This also includes the villages of Perkins, Saint-Pierre-de-Wakefield, Poltimore, Wakefield, Sainte-Cécile-de-Masham, Lascelles, Duclos, Lac-des-Loups, Luskville and Quyon. For addresses near the boundary, including Val-des-Bois, send your city or postal code so we can confirm travel and arrange your appointment with you.

items.question: How much does replacement cost?
items.answer: We prepare a quote for your vehicle and the windshield it needs. Send your vehicle details, VIN if you have it and your location, and we’ll clarify the work and price with you before you agree to go ahead.

items.question: Does my request confirm an appointment?
items.answer: Your request simply starts the conversation. We then work through the details, location and availability with you. You can confirm your appointment once we’ve agreed on those details together.

items.question: My vehicle has a camera. What about calibration?
items.answer: Tell us about any cameras or driver assistance features so we can work through those needs with you. If ADAS calibration is required, we’ll refer you to an appropriate provider and help clarify that step before confirming the replacement.

items.question: Do you offer repair or replacement?
items.answer: Our service is windshield replacement. If you’re unsure whether you need repair or replacement, start by describing the damage and your vehicle: we’ll help you understand the next step before agreeing on the work.

items.question: Can I contact you about a business vehicle?
items.answer: Yes, you’re welcome to contact us about a business vehicle. Share the number and type of vehicles and their location so we can discuss your needs and confirm together whether we can take on the work.

items.question: Can my insurance cover the replacement?
items.answer: Your insurer can confirm the coverage and deductible under your policy. We can prepare a quote for your claim so you can check with them what amount, if any, you would need to pay.
